Baseball players: a messy test dataset

dg_baseball.Rd

Career records for the 678 major league players whose first appearance (debut) fell in 2010-2014. Every column is text exactly as it arrived - written and ISO dates, dollar-formatted salaries, `R`/`L`/`B` codes, and non-US birthplaces in `birthState` - so typing and stabilizing have real work to do. Pair it with [dg_baseball_dictionary] for labels and descriptions; `vignette("example-guides")` builds a research guide from it.

Usage

dg_baseball

Format

A data frame with 678 rows and 19 character variables:

nameFirst, nameLast

player's first and last name.

birthDate

date of birth, written `Mon DD, YYYY`.

birthYear, birthMonth

year and month (`Mon`) of birth.

birthState, birthCity

place of birth: a US state code or a region name elsewhere, and a city.

weight, height

weight in pounds and height in inches.

bats, throws

batting side (`R`/`L`/`B`) and throwing hand (`R`/`L`).

debut, finalGame

dates of first and last appearance, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

G, AB, H

career games, at bats and hits.

AVG, SLUG

career batting average and slugging percentage; blank with no recorded at bats.

salary

salary, written `$851,950`.

Source

A subset of the baseball test file `data-dev/bb.csv` in the datagoodr source repository; built by `data-raw/dg_baseball.R`.
